# One Dollar Computer — Curriculum agent brief
# https://onedollarcomputer.com/curriculum/

## PATCH /lessons/:id — body fields

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| overview | string | Lesson intro text |
| materials | string[] | One item per line |
| steps | string[] | One step per line |
| photos | { url }[] | Image URLs |
| videos | { url }[] | YouTube URLs |
| links | { label?, url }[] | External links |
| **html** | { title?, **html** }[] | **HTML5 blocks shown inline in the lesson** |

Use **`html`**, not `gameHtml`, not iframe in overview. Each block: `{ "title": "…", "html": "<!doctype html>…" }`.

Aliases accepted by API: `games`, `gameHtml`, `game_html` (mapped to `html`).

## Agent → Copy

Run the copied shell block. Then PATCH with `$TOKEN` set. Do not create local HTML files.

## MCP tools

curriculum_pair, curriculum_list_lessons, curriculum_get_lesson, curriculum_update_lesson (field `html`).
